message: I am thinking...: Potential PoC strategies: (1) raw NMEA $PASHR,SAT with n > MAXCHANNELS; parser has unbounded loop and would write overflow, not matching READ in fill_dop. (2) Structured harness bytes encode a gps_device_t/session and/or packet fields, so set satellites_visible=185, received includes SATELLITE_SET, and skyview array has only 184 elements; gpsd_poll calls fill_dop and reads skyview[184]. Need infer byte layout. (3) If FuzzedDataProvider consumes fields in source order, little-endian booleans/ints may be enough; use large repeated bytes causing many fields true, enum values. We can submit multiple candidates with int/varint/protobuf encodings.
